title: Exposing Blindspots: Cultural Bias Evaluation in Generative Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image generation and image-to-image iterative editing across six countries (China, India, Kenya, Korea, Nigeria, U.S.) using era-aware prompts and an 8-category/36-subcategory schema, assessed via automatic metrics, a VQA-based culture-aware metric, and emic expert human evaluation.

Generating images for 12 occupations derived from the WinoBias benchmark using strictly gender-neutral prompts and classifying the resulting outputs by perceived gender to identify occupational demographic skews.
Generating images for 12 occupations using strictly gender-neutral prompts and classifying the outputs by perceived skin tone to identify representation disparities across roles.
